import sqlite3
def get_user(user_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    # VULNERABILITY: direct string interpolation into SQL query
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = {user_id}")
    return cursor.fetchone()
conn.close()
